classifications.migrate-later: An active legacy contract that a later phase renames; the compatibility contract must understand both spellings until Phase 5 retires the old one.
classifications.alias-sla: An active legacy contract that stays valid as an alias for the whole compatibility window; the AGRO spelling wins a conflict.
classifications.retained-generic: A name that is internal, generic, or historical and is not renamed by the migration.
classifications.obsolete: A retired contract that only appears in guards, history, or tests asserting its absence; a prefix rename must never reactivate it.

OH_HOME.note: Registry home; resolved through resolveUserStateHome since Phase 0. Since Phase 2 an absent pair resolves to ~/.agro, so a fresh registry is ~/.agro/sandboxes; an existing ~/.oh registry keeps resolving and agro migrate --home moves it.

OH_PROJECT_ROOT.note: Image ENV and entrypoint anchor for /home/sandbox/harness; CLI reads go through the alias resolver. Since Phase 2 both this spelling and AGRO_PROJECT_ROOT are in config-render RETIRED_KEYS, so neither is ever rendered into the compose environment.

OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE.note: Compose interpolation key and CLI override; the CLI reads either spelling, renders and threads AGRO_SANDBOX_IMAGE (with this spelling beside it for older compose files), and the compose files fall back to this spelling since Phase 2.

OH_PULL_POLICY.note: Compose interpolation key; since Phase 2 the CLI renders AGRO_PULL_POLICY and the compose files fall back to this spelling so a legacy registry entry rendered by an older CLI still works.

OH_REPO_DIR.note: Compose interpolation key for the checkout bind; since Phase 2 the CLI renders AGRO_REPO_DIR and the compose files fall back to this spelling.

OH_HOME_MOUNT.note: Compose interpolation key for the home mount; since Phase 2 the CLI renders AGRO_HOME_MOUNT and the compose files fall back to this spelling.

OH_IMAGE_SEED_SRC.note: Entrypoint seed source override; aliased since Phase 0.

OH_HOME_SEED_SRC.note: Baked-home seed override read by seed_home.

OH_COMPAT_SH.note: Test seam for the boot-safe adapter path; internal.

OH_BIN.note: Entrypoint override for the CLI executable name; since Phase 2 resolved through compat_env BIN with the default agro.

OH_PYTHON_KERNEL_HOME.note: Kernel home override; default lives under ~/.local/share/oh/. Phase 2 did not rename that directory: provision-python.sh still writes ~/.local/share/oh/kernel and ~/.local/share/oh/python-env.sh.

OH_ASSET_ROOT.note: Build-time asset root for the isolated CLI bundle; not a runtime contract.

OH_BIN_DIR.note: Installer control; the AGRO_BIN_DIR alias is delivered in get-agro.sh (Phase 1) with this spelling as the fallback.

OH_JS_URL.note: Installer control; the AGRO_JS_URL alias is delivered in get-agro.sh (Phase 1), and agro update reads the same pair for a standalone upgrade.

OH_GITHUB_REPO.note: get-oh.sh source repository for its build fallback. In get-agro.sh, AGRO_GITHUB_REPO (fallback OH_GITHUB_REPO) selects the repository whose latest release hosts agro.js; there is no source fallback.

OH_GITHUB_REF.note: get-oh.sh source ref for its build fallback. The AGRO_GITHUB_REF spelling is intentionally unimplemented: get-agro.sh has no source fallback; this variable retires with get-oh.sh.

OH_INSTALL_REF.note: Older alias of OH_GITHUB_REF; retires with the managed source-checkout installer.

OH_SCRIPTS_REF.note: Docs-site source ref; the agro-web build resolver reads AGRO_SCRIPTS_REF before OH_SCRIPTS_REF and defaults to main. The core repository only names it in the agro-web-pipeline knowledge page and the pages.yml documentation. Stays through the SLA.

OH_NVM_VERSION.note: Installer Node bootstrap control; the AGRO_NVM_VERSION alias is delivered in get-agro.sh (Phase 1).

OH_SKIP_EPILOGUE.note: Installer-internal handshake between install.sh and get-oh.sh.

OH_ASSUME_YES.note: Installer non-interactive switch; the AGRO_ASSUME_YES alias is delivered in get-agro.sh (Phase 1), with OH_ASSUME_YES as the fallback.

OH_REPLACE.note: Managed source-checkout installer control; retires with install.sh under Q2.

OH_HERMES_SMOKE.note: CI smoke gate for disposable Hermes sandboxes.

OH_REGISTRY_CHECKOUT.note: Probe input naming a skills-registry checkout.

OH_CONFIG_FIELDS.note: TypeScript constant, not an environment variable.

OH_IMAGE_ONLY.note: Retired flavor flag; probes assert it never returns.

OH_PROVISION_DEFAULTS.note: Retired boot-time install gate; probes assert it never returns.

OH_CONFIG_DIR.note: Retired $HOME config surface; probes assert it never returns.

OH_CLOUD_CONFIG.note: Retired $HOME config surface; probes assert it never returns.

.oh/.note: Project control plane; both spellings resolve through resolveControlDir since Phase 0. Delivered in Phase 2: this repository's tree is .agro/, an absent pair resolves to .agro/, and agro migrate renames an existing .oh/ and re-points the five provider links. A legacy .oh/ keeps resolving through the SLA.

oh.json.note: Project config; both spellings resolve through resolveConfigFile since Phase 0. Delivered in Phase 2: the tracked file is agro.json, ohConfigPath writes agro.json when no config exists, and agro migrate renames an existing oh.json. A legacy oh.json keeps resolving through the SLA.

.oh/.image-seeded.note: First-boot marker; the entrypoint recognizes either since Phase 0. Since Phase 2 a fresh volume is seeded as .agro/ with .agro/.image-seeded, and a legacy .oh/ workspace keeps this marker and is never re-seeded.

~/.oh/sandboxes/.note: Host sandbox registry; userStateMigrationSpec moves only this subtree. Delivered in Phase 2: a fresh registry entry is ~/.agro/sandboxes/<name>/agro.json with the default name prefix agro-sbx-, and agro migrate --home moves an existing ~/.oh registry. An unmigrated registry keeps resolving.

~/.openharness.note: Legacy managed product checkout (install.sh). Never registry content; preserved until the operator authorizes cleanup (Q2).

/opt/oh-seed.note: Image seed. Since Phase 2 the Dockerfile stages only /opt/agro-seed; compat_seed_src still prefers this path when a legacy image ships it.

/opt/oh-assets.note: Retired in Phase 2: the image stages /opt/agro-assets for the isolated CLI build and the entrypoint's compat adapter; no runtime reads this path.

/opt/oh.note: Image-internal CLI install root; dist/oh.js is linked as /usr/local/bin/oh and, since Phase 1, dist/agro.js as /usr/local/bin/agro. agro update refuses this location.

~/.config/openharness/cloud.json.note: Cloud CLI stored settings; owned by the Cloud phase.

~/.local/share/oh/.note: Python kernel home and python-env.sh written by provision-python.sh. Not renamed in Phase 2 — provision-python.sh and the Dockerfile shell hook still write and read this path; the AGRO spelling is unimplemented.

.oh/scripts/get-oh.sh.note: Installer. get-agro.sh (artifact-only, AGRO_*/OH_* aliases) is delivered in Phase 1; get-oh.sh is retained unchanged, including its source-build fallback, through the SLA. Since the Phase 2 tree rename both scripts live at .agro/scripts/; the published asset names are unchanged.

.oh/scripts/install.sh.note: Managed source-checkout installer; retired by Q2 without deleting existing checkouts. Since the Phase 2 tree rename the file sits at .agro/scripts/install.sh, and Phase 2 removed its clone-and-own, fork, and one-line recipes from README, quickstart, installation, and contributing.

dist/oh.js.note: CLI bundle name. Delivered in Phase 1: dist/oh.js is a byte-identical copy of dist/agro.js; product identity comes from the invoked executable name.

@mifune/openharness.note: npm package. Delivered in Phase 1 as a delegation shim that ships only the oh bin and pins the exact @mifune/agro version; deprecated on publish, installable through the SLA.

ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness.note: Image name. Dual-published beside ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro from Phase 1 (four tags from one digest, latest on both); the default image ref switch stays Phase 3; legacy tags remain as intentional aliases.

openharness (sandbox identity).note: Unnamed compose project/container fallback; since Phase 2 the compose files, the wrapper, and the CLI fall back to `agro` (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_NAME in compat). This repository keeps name openharness in agro.json, and every configured name stays mapped.
